features.name: Spot multipliers to 1,024x

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Scatters trigger free spins where marked spots and their multipliers carry through the round.

review:
The candy cluster game on a 7x7 grid, now with much bigger multipliers. Five or more touching symbols win and tumble away.

Each exploding symbol marks its square; a second explosion there adds a 2x multiplier that doubles with every hit – now all the way up to 1,024x – and multipliers under a winning cluster apply to it. Watching the grid build up is the whole fun. Long quiet stretches in between, though. 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
